name: dragon
description: Kill the ender dragon in the End. NEEDS A REAL DRAGON: a /summon'ed ender_dragon has no EnderDragonFight controller, so it hovers motionless where you put it and never circles, perches or attacks - an inert 200 hp target, not a fight. Use a world whose End still has its dragon, or respawn one properly with four end crystals on the exit portal. The summon below is a placeholder for that.
goal: You are on the End island with a bow, arrows, a diamond sword, diamond armour and a carved pumpkin already worn on your head. The pumpkin is why endermen ignore you - do NOT take it off or swap it for a helmet. Kill the ender dragon. Start a snippet with `use "lib/dragon"`: `shoot_crystals()` destroys the end crystals on the pillars (they heal the dragon, so they go first - it returns how many it got), then `fight_dragon()` melees the dragon when it perches on the fountain and shoots it with the bow while it flies. Keep each call short and check your arrows and health between calls; eat or use a golden apple below half health. Never dig down here - below the island is the void. Say 'dragon dead' when it dies. You have 320 arrows: spend them on the dragon, and do not keep firing at a crystal that is caged in iron bars - break the cage or leave it.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add -32 -32 32 32
execute in minecraft:the_end run summon minecraft:ender_dragon 0 80 0
